'''''Geropogon''''' is a [[genus]] of flowering plants in the family [[Asteraceae]].<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/11834496#page/326/mode/1up Linnaeus, Carl von. 1763.  Species Plantarum, Editio Secunda 1109] in Latin</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40013879 Tropicos, ''Geropogon'' L.]</ref>

==Species==
Several species names have been published in the genus, but only one is recognized. '''''Geropogon hybridus''''', the '''pasture goatsbeard'''<ref>{{PLANTS|id=TRHY7|taxon=Tragopogon hybridus|accessdate=14 December 2015}}</ref> or '''slender salsify''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> is native to the [[Mediterranean]] and adjacent areas, from the [[Canary Islands]] to [[Iran]].<ref name=a>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20141130064513/http://dixon.iplantcollaborative.org/CompositaeWeb/Default.aspx?Page=NameDetails&TabNum=3&nameId=9266131e-71b1-473c-b12d-673029183768|title=Flann, C (ed) 2009+ Global Compositae Checklist}}</ref><ref>[http://www.theplantlist.org/tpl1.1/record/gcc-77575 The Plant List, ''Geropogon hybridus'' (L.) Sch.Bip.]</ref>
